plan.title: Decompose src/dashboard/server/routes/issues.ts (4065 lines) into focused modules
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: src/dashboard/server/routes/issues.ts is 4,110 lines (baselined god file #2 in the server). It mixes HTTP transport with at least five domains' logic: planning lifecycle (~1,300 lines), issue transitions (~900), PR/CI reads (~380), discussions (~350), workspace hygiene (~280), plus 10 copies of the same project-path resolution boilerplate. Every planning-pipeline change lands inside it.
narratives.Proposal: Per the PRD's explicit approach override (orchestrator decision 2026-07-02, supersedes the issue body's barrel-split ask): thin every route handler to a parse -> door call -> jsonResponse adapter and relocate domain logic verbatim into eight door modules under src/lib/overdeck/ (pull-requests, discussions, workspace-hygiene, planning-promotion, planning-sessions, task-generation, issue-transitions, issue-reads). routes/issues.ts keeps all 29 HttpRouter.add registrations and issuesRouteLayer, ending under 1,000 lines. No re-export shims - the handful of importers (reconstruct-cache.ts dynamic import + seven test files) are repointed in the same commit as each move. One seam per commit in WI-1..WI-9 order; typecheck+lint+build+named tests per seam; full suite after WI-4 and before merge (TENET-10).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No routes/issues/ barrel subdirectory (the issue body's approach - explicitly rejected by the PRD; the workspaces barrel split created merge-ops.ts, a 1,925-line god file)
- No migration onto IssuesResolver/IssueWriter Effect services and no deletion of scattered read endpoints (PAN-1936 / PAN-2008)
- No behavior change, endpoint addition/removal, or response-shape change
- No touching routes/agents.ts (PAN-2147) or routes/conversations.ts (PAN-2145)
- No rewrite of reconstruct-cache.ts's dynamic-import pattern (only its path changes)
- No fixing of moved `any` types (allowlist instead - behavior-preserving)
- Never POST deep-wipe during verification

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the PRD's two-door route-thinning approach over the issue body's barrel split without halting for a contradiction.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-2148.md contains an explicit, dated orchestrator decision (2026-07-02) rejecting the barrel approach with evidence (workspaces barrel split produced the 1,925-line merge-ops.ts god file). The contradiction is already resolved inside the authoritative artifact; halting would bounce a decision a human already made in writing.

autoDecisions.summary: Inspection gates on exactly two beads: WI-1 (fast) and WI-4 (deep).
autoDecisions.rationale: WI-1 establishes the door-module + thin-adapter + repoint-in-same-commit pattern every later seam copies (foundation). WI-4 moves pipeline-runtime machinery containing the PAN-1124 single-writer spec-status mutation path (architectural/security-adjacent surface). All other seams are mechanically analogous moves whose defects surface at typecheck or their named tests.

autoDecisions.summary: All nine beads are serialized (WI-1 -> ... -> WI-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: Every seam edits the same routes/issues.ts; parallel dispatch would conflict. The PRD's D5 also mandates one seam per commit, safest first.
